finding: Forge intentionally represents the provider-neutral transient revealed state as cards physically remaining in Library plus native reveal state tied to the actual RememberRevealed stack source. The already-applied Java half of scripts/ws40_v103_native_revealed_state.py constructs this native state and fail-closes unless isNativelyRevealed(game, card) is true. Its raw native observation emits native_revealed. The WS45 v1.0.4 construction normalizer currently projects raw zone directly and therefore loses the provider-neutral revealed semantic. This is a bounded observation-normalization integration defect, not a rules, identity, or no-request-echo regression.
